name.description: The name is how it is displayed on your site (for example: English).

slug.description: Language code - preferably 2-letters ISO 639-1 (for example: en).

locale.description: WordPress Locale for the language (for example: en_US).

term_group.description: Position of the language in the language switcher.

flag_code.description: Flag code corresponding to ISO 3166-1 (for example: us for the United States flag).

no_default_cat.description: Tells whether the default category must be created when creating a new language.

context.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

browser.description: Detect preferred browser language on front page: `true` to detect, `false` to not detect.

rewrite.description: Remove `/language/` in pretty permalinks: `true` to remove, `false` to keep.

hide_default.description: Remove the language code in URL for the default language: `true` to hide, `false` to display.

force_lang.description: Determine how the current language is defined.

redirect_lang.description: Remove the page name or page ID from the URL of the front page: `true` to remove, `false` to keep.

post_types.description: List of post types to translate.

domains.description: Domains used when the language is set from different domains.

nav_menus.description: Translated navigation menus for each theme.
